cooked: The shared state is only as well-defined as the validation rules every indexer applies. Since Bitcoin consensus does not reject malformed Shielded Bitcoin transfers, a circuit or encoding change could leave older wallets accepting a different note set from newer ones. The spec should pin versioning and activation rules, and include test vectors for replaying the same history across implementations.
